object: Joule-heated amine-sorbent CO2 capture filter for demand-controlled ventilation
problem: Can a regenerable CO2 filter plus optimized demand-controlled ventilation cut indoor ventilation energy while holding CO2 at 600 ppm?
mechanism_or_method: Amine silica sprayed on carbon fiber regenerated by Joule heating; differential evolution with DNN surrogate optimizes control parameters.
limitation: Energy savings come from simulation, not field building operation.
decision_relevance: Supports sizing CO2 filters versus fresh-air ventilation in building HVAC design.

object: global agricultural and forestry residue-to-energy systems
problem: How does global residue-based bioenergy deployment affect selected Sustainable Development Goals across regions and scenarios to 2060?
mechanism_or_method: Global Change Analysis Model integrated with life cycle assessment in an optimized integrated residue-to-energy framework under SSP-RCP scenarios.
limitation: Scenario-based projections depend on model assumptions; low-income regions poorly resolved.
decision_relevance: Guides regional prioritisation of residue bioenergy deployment policy.

object: recyclable block copolymer multistate material
problem: Can one polymer switch reversibly between tough rigid states and soft states via dual-phase crystalline control?
mechanism_or_method: Self-assembled block copolymer nanostructures with dual-phase crystallinity control giving circuit-like transitions between multiple mechanical states.
limitation: Lab-scale samples; long-term cycling and processing scalability not shown in abstract.
decision_relevance: Informs material choice for impact-resistant, switchable-stiffness components.

object: feather star-inspired soft swimming robot
problem: Can a soft robot achieve multimodal 3D swimming maneuverability with minimal actuation?
mechanism_or_method: Mechanically intelligent feather star-inspired body design that converts few actuation inputs into multiple swimming modes.
limitation: Abstract gives no performance metrics; tested only in laboratory water conditions.
decision_relevance: Suggests morphology-based control to reduce actuator count in swimming robots.

object: biohybrid mesh energy harvester in cardiac tissue
problem: Can distributed harvesting units in a tissue-like mesh convert biomechanical energy more densely than centralized substrate harvesters?
mechanism_or_method: Mesh network of individual harvesting units mimicking tissue mechanics, embedded within in vitro cardiac tissue.
limitation: Demonstrated only in vitro; in vivo performance and biocompatibility unproven.
decision_relevance: Favors distributed mesh architectures for powering bio-integrated implants.

object: fluorine-free aqueous binder for lithium-ion battery electrodes
problem: Can a water-processable fluorine-free binder match PVDF performance while enabling direct electrode recycling?
mechanism_or_method: Polyacrylic acid and carboxymethyl cellulose crosslinked by citric acid forming hydrogen, covalent and ionic bonding network.
limitation: Demonstrated mainly on LiFePO4 coin-scale cells; large-format cycling and cost not validated.
decision_relevance: Supports switching battery electrode manufacturing to aqueous fluorine-free binders.

object: soft pneumatic robot fluidic demultiplexer/multiplexer circuits
problem: How can fluidic control scale to many degrees of freedom across sizes while remaining compliant?
mechanism_or_method: High-radix demultiplexing with time multiplexing, using dimensionless-parameter valve design to preserve thresholds across scales and stretchable structure.
limitation: Demonstrated on bench prototypes; switching speed and durability in untethered robots unclear.
decision_relevance: Enables onboard fluidic control with fewer inputs in soft robot design.

object: nucleic acid nanoparticles formed by freezing
problem: Can freezing-induced microphase separation compress nucleic acids into functional nanoparticles without excipients?
mechanism_or_method: Ice crystallization pressure and freeze-concentration drive supramolecular chain formation and compaction into nanoparticles, supported by molecular dynamics.
limitation: Delivery efficacy shown in cell lines and limited in vivo models; scalability unclear.
decision_relevance: none

object: global cobalt availability by ownership and trade
problem: How do foreign investment and international trade redistribute country-level cobalt availability relative to geographic production?
mechanism_or_method: Dual-attribution accounting framework assigning primary availability by corporate ownership and secondary availability by trade across 229 economies.
limitation: Depends on ownership and trade data quality; equal weighting of primary and secondary availability is arbitrary.
decision_relevance: none

object: nanosized single crystals of Fe-Mn-Co-Cr multi-principal element alloy
problem: Why do nanosized MPEA single crystals combine ~3 GPa strength with ~20% uniform elongation?
mechanism_or_method: In-situ atomic-scale tensile testing showing inhomogeneous enthalpy produces broad nucleation barriers, spreading dislocations and nanotwins and suppressing stress concentration.
limitation: Single alloy composition at nanoscale; transfer to bulk components not shown.
decision_relevance: Guides composition design for strong and ductile nanoscale metals.

object: DLP-printed hydrogels for soft robotics
problem: How can printed hydrogels become both highly stretchable and strong despite short-strand networks from rapid curing?
mechanism_or_method: Post-print alkaline cleavage of o-nitrobenzyl acetal crosslinks lengthens strands, with hydrophobic side groups inducing phase-separated reinforcing domains.
limitation: Alkaline post-processing and hydrogel hydration limit long-term stability and application environments.
decision_relevance: Provides printable material route for large-deformation soft actuators.

object: end-of-life NdFeB magnet recycling by molten salt electrolysis
problem: Can neodymium be recovered from scrap magnets continuously with high efficiency and lower impact than primary production?
mechanism_or_method: Molten salt electrolysis with magnet anodes and consumable solid Mg cathode forming liquid Mg-Nd alloy, plus LCA and techno-economics.
limitation: Lab-scale cells; industrial 3000 A economics are extrapolated scenarios.
decision_relevance: Supports process choice for rare-earth magnet recycling plants.

object: plant-derived solar vapor generation evaporator
problem: Can a plant-structured composite evaporator deliver high solar water purification rates cheaply and sustainably?
mechanism_or_method: Perforated carbon-black wood slices, nanocellulose aerogel and aligned wheat straws giving low-tortuosity water transport and interfacial evaporation.
limitation: Outdoor tests short; salt fouling and durability over long operation not reported.
decision_relevance: Informs low-cost biomass evaporator design for off-grid desalination.

object: impurity-tolerant ductile iron made from contaminated scrap
problem: Can alloys be designed to exploit scrap contaminants rather than dilute them while retaining strength and ductility?
mechanism_or_method: Deep-neural-network optimization coupled with experiments to find impurity-tolerant processing windows that integrate contaminants into a purposeful microstructure.
limitation: Demonstrated on a model ductile iron; other scrap chemistries and industrial casting untested.
decision_relevance: Allows higher scrap fractions in cast iron production without virgin dilution.

object: polymer-polymer contact electrification
problem: What drives charge separation in contact electrification, and can electric fields control its magnitude and polarity?
mechanism_or_method: Externally applied electric fields during contact-friction-separation alter surface charge, compared with simulations of flexoelectric field magnitude.
limitation: Flexoelectric origin is inferred from field magnitude matching, not directly isolated.
decision_relevance: Informs static charge mitigation and triboelectric generator design.

object: olivine surface carbonation for CO2 mineralization
problem: Why is Ca-olivine far more reactive than Mg-olivine toward CO2 mineralization?
mechanism_or_method: Multiscale simulation showing nonbridging oxygens drive surface CO2 reactions, lowering Ca2+ dissolution barrier by 60%.
limitation: Computed rates validated against limited experiments; real basalt reservoir complexity not modeled.
decision_relevance: none

object: Pt single-atom catalysts for VOC oxidation under SO2
problem: How can Pt single-atom catalysts resist SO2 poisoning in benzene oxidation?
mechanism_or_method: In situ sulfation converts poisoning sulfite to sulfate and extracts Pt single atoms onto MnSO4, forming active Pt1-SO4 motif.
limitation: Tested up to 300 h in lab gas streams, not real industrial exhaust.
decision_relevance: none

object: spent LiFePO4 conversion to thin lithium metal electrodes
problem: Can residual lithium in spent LiFePO4 be directly upcycled into usable thin lithium metal anodes?
mechanism_or_method: Redox mediator-assisted extraction and regeneration producing lithium foils with preformed interphase, closed-loop.
limitation: Used simulated spent powder rather than real spent batteries.
decision_relevance: none

object: nonlinear perturbative elastic metamaterials for computing
problem: How can metamaterial geometries be designed to perform target nonlinear computations without searching a huge geometry space?
mechanism_or_method: Nonlinear localized map from metamaterial deformations to a tight-binding model encoding computation, then geometry tailoring for Ising, memory and speech tasks.
limitation: Designs validated numerically; physical fabrication and noise robustness not demonstrated in abstract.
decision_relevance: Offers design route for mechanical computing metamaterials.

object: origami-inspired nanofiber aerogels
problem: How can layered nanofiber aerogels gain mechanical robustness and resilience while keeping low thermal conductivity?
mechanism_or_method: Folded-interlocked origami skeleton with fibrous interlaminar network providing geometric confinement and delamination resistance.
limitation: Lab-scale samples; extreme-environment durability and aging not reported.
decision_relevance: Guides architecture choice for lightweight thermal protection in aerospace.

object: stacking-fault-programmed crystalline metallacycle membranes
problem: How can crystalline membranes break the permeability-selectivity trade-off for precise molecular fractionation?
mechanism_or_method: Interfacial coordination self-assembly of metallacycles with stacking-fault misalignment creating graded steric confinement and entropy-dominated transport.
limitation: Lab-scale membranes; long-term stability and cost estimates are model-based.
decision_relevance: none

object: crowded PAAc-Ca hydrogel with associative bonds
problem: How do elasticity and diffusion kinetics determine nonequilibrium thermal phase separation and vitrification in crowded hydrogels?
mechanism_or_method: Compare quasi-static isobaric and rapid quasi-isochoric heating paths; demixing pressure scales with network shear modulus, Pc/Gx about 100.
limitation: Single hydrogel chemistry; generality of Pc/Gx ratio untested.
decision_relevance: none

object: reverse osmosis membranes with hydroxy artificial water channels
problem: Can artificial water channels raise N-nitrosamine rejection and water permeance beyond the permselectivity upper bound?
mechanism_or_method: Hydroxy artificial water channels in polyamide layer form dynamic OH-H2O hydrogen-bond networks enabling fast water passage while blocking NDMA and NaCl.
limitation: Lab-scale coupons; fouling and long-term stability under real wastewater not reported.
decision_relevance: none

object: fault gouge fragmentation and slip localization
problem: How does grain fragmentation link to fault-zone architecture and weakening leading to earthquake nucleation?
mechanism_or_method: Discrete element simulations of quartz gouge with dynamic grain fragmentation yielding a strain-damage law and fragmentation state variable.
limitation: Idealized grain shapes and 2D/discrete model compared with limited laboratory data.
decision_relevance: Provides a state variable for fault friction constitutive laws.

object: micropatterned PEGDA antifogging hydrogel
problem: How can transparency be maintained under extreme condensation where coatings fail?
mechanism_or_method: Micropatterned wicking structure on a hydrophilic hydrogel guided by optics, wetting theory and diffusion timescales, sustaining filmwise condensation.
limitation: Hydrogel durability, swelling and abrasion resistance in long-term use not addressed.
decision_relevance: Guides antifogging surface selection for high-humidity or boiling environments.

object: The Geysers geothermal field fracture network and microseismicity
problem: How does permeability heterogeneity control fluid migration and microseismicity in The Geysers over the past decade?
mechanism_or_method: Deep-learning microseismic catalog with Markov clustering, source mechanism analysis and pore pressure diffusion simulation.
limitation: Fracture network inferred indirectly from seismicity; pore pressure simulation simplified.
decision_relevance: Informs injection placement and seismic hazard management in geothermal reservoirs.

object: polyamide nanofiltration membranes made with Hofmeister ions
problem: Can weakly hydrated anions regulate interfacial polymerization to give thinner, denser polyamide layers?
mechanism_or_method: Chaotropic anions reduce amine-water affinity, speed monomer partitioning, lower interfacial tension and hydrolysis, forming hollow-ridged selective layers.
limitation: Module-scale demonstration limited; long-term fouling and ion residue effects unclear.
decision_relevance: none

object: electrified railway systems as energy storage
problem: How much grid storage potential can train operation modulation provide, and what is its system value?
mechanism_or_method: Analysis of 326,034 inter-stop train operations to estimate potential, then capacity expansion models for China, Europe and India.
limitation: Global potential extrapolated; passenger schedule constraints and real operational feasibility not tested.
decision_relevance: Supports counting rail traction flexibility in grid storage planning.

object: PEM reactor with porous solid electrolyte for bicarbonate-to-CO conversion
problem: Can captured carbon be directly electroreduced to CO with high carbon efficiency in acidic PEM reactors?
mechanism_or_method: Porous solid electrolyte layer regulates proton transport, limits bubble accumulation and aids CO2 transport, verified by in situ visualization cell.
limitation: Lab-scale cell; long-term stability and scale-up not shown in abstract.
decision_relevance: Informs reactor layer design for integrated carbon capture and electroconversion.

object: photosynthetic microalgae-hydrogel living actuator
problem: Can microalgae metabolism drive reversible bending of a pH-responsive hydrogel using light?
mechanism_or_method: Chlamydomonas photosynthesis and N-assimilation ionize the polymer network in light; respiration CO2 protonates it in darkness, bending a bilayer.
limitation: Large bending takes about 18 hours; only 10 cycles demonstrated.
decision_relevance: none

object: ventral-groove fibers for pneumatic actuation
problem: Can fiber architectures enable large, low-pressure, volume-programmable pneumatic actuation across scales?
mechanism_or_method: Bioinspired microgroove unfolding coupled with elastic expansion gives reversible 400x area expansion at about 0.8 kPa.
limitation: Fatigue life and air-tightness of long fibers under repeated use not reported.
decision_relevance: Enables low-pressure pneumatic textile and gripper designs.

object: desert locust hindleg tarsus friction
problem: How does hemolymph pressure modulate tarsal friction during jumping attachment and detachment?
mechanism_or_method: Controlled friction tests, high-speed video, microscopy and biomimetic prototypes show pressure-tuned stiffness plus structural asymmetry yields direction-dependent friction.
limitation: Low-speed contact conditions only; link to real jumping is hypothesised.
decision_relevance: Suggests pressure-tuned compliant contacts for robot grippers and legs.

object: spider-inspired soft robotic joint with electrohydraulic actuators
problem: Can a soft joint rotate bidirectionally without antagonistic actuators or extra restriction modules?
mechanism_or_method: Pair of synchronously driven electrohydraulic actuators generating multiaxial strain so rotation direction depends on the joint's physical state.
limitation: Centimeter-scale prototypes; payload capacity and lifetime under high voltage limited.
decision_relevance: Allows single-channel bidirectional joints in compact soft robots.

object: low-grade carbon fiber felts processed by laser
problem: Can roll-to-roll laser processing turn short chopped carbon fibers into strong conductive functional films?
mechanism_or_method: Liquid precursor laser-induced graphene at fiber-fiber interfaces creates conductive and mechanical interconnections on a custom roll-to-roll platform.
limitation: Lightning protection tested on small samples; throughput and cost at industrial scale unclear.
decision_relevance: Supports reuse of chopped carbon fiber waste for de-icing and lightning protection layers.

object: cephalopod-inspired adaptive camouflage system
problem: Can a closed-loop display camouflage evade both human observers and object detectors in physical scenes?
mechanism_or_method: Eye-brain-skin pipeline: environment color extraction, optimization-based texture generation balancing naturalness and evasion, angle-aware OLED display compensation.
limitation: Demonstrated on a model vehicle with specific detectors; generalization to other detectors unclear.
decision_relevance: none

object: cadmium recovery and aqueous Cd metal anodes
problem: Can Cd waste electrolytes be converted into regenerable, stable aqueous battery anodes in a closed loop?
mechanism_or_method: Potential-programmed electrodeposition yields Cd(002)-textured electrodes; cesium iodide additive reconstructs the electrode-electrolyte interface.
limitation: Used model waste electrolytes rather than real industrial zinc-processing waste.
decision_relevance: none

object: partially partitioned metal-organic frameworks
problem: Can lower-symmetry ligands yield partial pore-space partition that keeps capacity while improving acetylene selectivity?
mechanism_or_method: Framework desymmetrization with C2h ligands such as fumaric acid distorts the acs net so partition agents fill only a fraction of sites.
limitation: Powder-scale adsorption and breakthrough data; scale-up and moisture stability not discussed.
decision_relevance: none

object: skin-like supramolecular entangled hydrogel
problem: Can one hydrogel combine skin-like mechanics, multiple functions and multimodal sensing?
mechanism_or_method: Entangled supramolecular network reinforced with hydrogen-bond nanodomains, electrostatic interactions and reversible metal-ligand coordination.
limitation: Hydrogel water loss and long-term durability in wearable use not addressed in abstract.
decision_relevance: none

object: green laser directed energy deposition of AA7075 aluminum alloy
problem: Can green laser DED of TiC-modified AA7075 powder yield crack-free ultrahigh-strength aluminum?
mechanism_or_method: Green laser improves absorptivity and melt pool stability; nano-TiC powder plus heat treatment produces dense eta-prime precipitates and GP zones.
limitation: Small deposited samples; fatigue, fracture toughness and part-scale residual stress not reported.
decision_relevance: Supports green laser and TiC powder choice for additive manufacturing of 7xxx aluminum.

object: crystalline 3D membranes for natural product purification
problem: Can organic solvent nanofiltration with crystalline membranes replace chromatography for purifying paclitaxel from crude extracts?
mechanism_or_method: Nanosphere-assembled interfacial polymerization forms rigid crystalline 3D membranes with stable channels giving molecular sieving in methanol.
limitation: Six-day lab operation on one extract type; industrial scale and fouling unproven.
decision_relevance: none

object: lamellar-cellular structured thermo-responsive hydrogel actuators
problem: How can hydrogels achieve rapid actuation, complex deformation and deformation-coupled information encryption?
mechanism_or_method: Multiscale lamellar-confined assembly polymerization with spatial orientation patterning gives periodic asymmetric stresses, porous water channels and tunable birefringence.
limitation: Thermo-responsive actuation in water only; cycling durability and scalability not shown.
decision_relevance: none

object: alkali-activated materials toughened with red mud-derived nanocarbon
problem: Can plastic pyrolysis over red mud co-produce hydrogen and CNT composites that toughen alkali-activated construction materials?
mechanism_or_method: Red mud catalyzes plastic pyrolysis to H2 and CNT/RM composites; 1 wt% additive bridges cracks and fills pores in binder.
limitation: Lab-scale mortar tests; durability and large-scale pyrolysis integration not shown.
decision_relevance: Supports using waste-derived CNTs as low-carbon toughening additives in binders.
